speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. To better understand your condition, can you tell me how long you have been experiencing the cough and shortness of breath, and does it worsen at night or with physical activity?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had this cough and shortness of breath for about eight weeks now. The breathing difficulty definitely gets worse when I try to walk fast or climb stairs, but it doesn't seem to bother me at night. speaker: Doctor
text: That duration suggests a subacute process. Given the exertional nature of your shortness of breath, I need to check your lung function. REQUEST TEST: Spirometry. Also, have you noticed any weight loss, night sweats, or blood in your sputum?

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Spirometry Findings: FEV1/FVC ratio less than 70%, indicating obstructive pattern. Reversibility test shows improvement with bronchodilator.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Acute exacerbation of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
